data.title: 周防天音 · 雨夜站台的红伞依偎
data.description: 暴雨倾盆的郊外公交车站凉亭外，水洼在夜色中倒映着昏黄路灯。天音撑着一把宽大的红色雨伞，整个身子小鸟依人地紧贴在雄二的身边。雨水打湿了她的美浜制服肩膀，但她却将伞的大半部分倾向雄二。深蓝的眸子里满溢着不言而喻的温柔，在淅淅沥沥的雨声中，无声传达着想要一辈子守护在雄二身旁的宿命誓言。
data.location: 雨夜郊外公交车站亭旁路灯下
data.action: 撑着红雨伞侧身紧紧依偎在对方身旁，雨水打湿发梢，眼神深情而柔和
data.lighting: 昏黄复古路灯穿透密密雨幕形成的温暖光晕与地面水洼倒影
data.camera: medium shot, couple proximity framing, moody rain atmosphere
data.promptProse: Amane presses against Yuuji at the bus shelter, long red hair spilling over the wet shoulder of her lavender uniform. Yuuji has short black hair and a dark rain jacket with its hood down. She tilts the red umbrella toward him while amber streetlamp reflections break across the puddled road.
data.animaCaption: Amane's long red hair and damp lavender school blouse show under the red umbrella. She leans against short black-haired Yuuji in a dark rain jacket and tips the canopy over him.
